title: Certified adaptive examination of blood smears: code, pre-registration and results
description: Code, pre-registration (git tags prereg-v1 to prereg-v4) and stored results for the study 'Certified Adaptive Examination of Blood Smears: Why Information-Gain Stopping Cannot Certify Rare Evidence, and What Can Be Guaranteed Instead'. This is a methodological and empirical study, not a clinical tool. The datasets are not redistributed; see REPRODUCE.md for their sources and licences.
